about: Every fact Angelo's instruction texts state, once: prompt_audit.py checks each route's RECORDED request holds the facts meant for it (doc/angelo/prompt_audit.rst). anchors: strings the received text must all contain, compared with whitespace collapsed (a list inside anchors is any-of); routes: the routes that must receive it (fnmatch patterns or an alias); review: routes that do not get it today and whose need is not yet settled (reported, never failed); stale: regular expressions for the name a script writes without the fact, used only as evidence. own_text_only: routes whose model reads only its own text (Studio's prompt editor): any fact meant only for other routes found in their recording is a leak, and fails. release_routes: routes a release must have a recording of (release_checks.py prompt-audit). foreign_absent: runtime text or tools Angelo turns off, which must not reach the listed routes. turn_facts: facts a first user message must carry when its condition holds (when: image). A fact changes here when the text's facts change, never to make a recording pass.

facts.says: The Blender release the scripts run in.
Sky Texture sky_type values; NISHITA was removed.
aerosol_density replaces dust_density.
Sun angles are radians (a literal of 7 or more is degrees).

anchors: sun_rotation is the sun's bearing seen from above, clockwise from +Y
facts.says: A scattering sky's sun_rotation is its bearing: 0 toward +Y, pi/2 toward +X.
Blender calls MULTIPLE_SCATTERING more accurate; its sky is bluer than SINGLE_SCATTERING's.
render.engine is BLENDER_EEVEE, BLENDER_WORKBENCH or CYCLES; no BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT.
An Action's F-curves are in channelbags (no Action.fcurves).

anchors: invert is a property, not a socket

angelo_blender_api answers API questions from the installed Blender.
angelo_blender_api also reports Python-layer members such as Mesh.from_pydata.
angelo_read_data reads stored values, enums and socket identifiers without approval.
